svg.text: APEXPM WALLSTREET — HOW THE BOT RUNS, DECIDES, PROTECTS ITSELF AND LEARNS
THE HARNESS — AROUND THE BOT, OUTSIDE ITS PROCESS
every strategy proposes a plan, or nothing
exit engine runs on every trade print
fills and cancels update orders at once
time exits fire even with no price
kill switch · daily loss · position limits · event days →
size set by volatility, inside hard caps
strike and expiry picked from the live chain
every scan, signal, rejection (and why), order intent, fill, exit, headline and decision
grades every strategy on its own record
checks it earns what its evidence promised
borderline cases → decisions for the owner
did every job run on time?
runs the repairs it is allowed to run
files a decision for anything it can't fix
lost its edge → benched to shadow (automatic)
new versions tested on data they've never seen
winners start as challengers in shadow
runs off the server, never trades
fixes the obvious, proposes the rest
a verified copy of the journal
promotes shadow → paper → live with evidence
reads the daily report, the audits and the weekly letter
Solid: data / control flow · Red dashed: locked path · Green dashed: decisions (never applied automatically) · Purple: harness outside the bot · Orange: owner actions
